verdicts.reason: A has a clear collision: the venue line '…Pier 9' runs into the tilted can graphic. 'Saturday 21 June' is jammed right under the subtitle's second line with no gap, and the subtitle wraps to an orphaned 'of the year'. B keeps the original's spacing and has no collisions, but it is mostly a scaled-down copy. The pill badges and URL text are small, the bottom third is dead space around the stray missing-asset box, and the big circle crowds the top-left behind the logo.
